easy.q: How many all-beef patties are in a McDonald's Big Mac?
easy.fact: The Big Mac went on sale nationwide in 1968.

easy.q: How many periods are in a regulation NHL game?
easy.fact: Each period lasts 20 minutes of game time.

easy.q: How many U.S. states have "Virginia" in their name?
easy.fact: West Virginia split from Virginia during the Civil War and became a state in 1863.

easy.q: How many jet engines power the Boeing 747s that fly as Air Force One?
easy.fact: "Air Force One" is the call sign for any Air Force plane carrying the president.

easy.q: Dua Lipa's hit New Rules counts off how many rules in its chorus?
easy.fact: It was her first No. 1 single in the U.K.

medium.q: In what year did Eminem's movie 8 Mile hit theaters?
medium.fact: Its song Lose Yourself won the Oscar for Best Original Song.

medium.q: How many teams make the NCAA men's basketball tournament field?
medium.fact: The field grew to 68 teams in 2011 with the First Four.

medium.q: Yellowstone's Old Faithful erupts on average about every how many minutes?
medium.fact: Its intervals range from about 50 to 127 minutes.

medium.q: Jamestown, the first lasting English colony in America, was founded in 1607. How many years later was the Declaration of Independence signed?
medium.fact: Jamestown sits on the James River in Virginia.

medium.q: How many wedges are on the wheel in Wheel of Fortune?
medium.fact: Pat Sajak hosted for 41 seasons before Ryan Seacrest took over in 2024.

hard.q: How tall is New York's Chrysler Building to the tip of its spire, in feet?
hard.fact: It was the world's tallest building for about 11 months, until the Empire State Building opened in 1931.

hard.q: How many pounds does the bronze Heisman Trophy weigh?
hard.fact: It's modeled on NYU running back Ed Smith, who posed for it in 1934.

hard.q: Britton Hill is Florida's highest point. How many feet above sea level is it?
hard.fact: It is the lowest high point of any U.S. state.

hard.q: Harry Styles' As It Was spent how many weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100?
hard.fact: That is the longest run at No. 1 for a British act.
